name: l2cap_detach_psm_registration

ownership.argument: Internal, channel-initiated removal of a PSM binding; NOT the public unregister handler. Recorded under this name so the module does not mistake it for the API entry (that is 0xC8030F0). Whether the queued 16-byte node is a retire request to the app could not be fully proven.

provenance.source: Derives the PSM from source+38 plus the kind nibble of msg+1, unlinks the matching entry from *(owner)+16 with 0xC7EAD28, then allocates a 16-byte request node with 0xC840C54(16) and copies source+16/+20 into it before queueing. Its two call sites are the channel paths 0xC800FE8 and 0xC802D2C, not the public API.

notes: Internal, channel-initiated removal of a PSM binding; NOT the public unregister handler. Recorded under this name so the module does not mistake it for the API entry (that is 0xC8030F0). Whether the queued 16-byte node is a retire request to the app could not be fully proven.
